# Experiment report (generated by `python -m app.compare analyze`)

* campaign: `stage7-example` (campaign mode); replicates per cell: 12; base seed: 20261028; run duration 12.0 s; probes 100.0 pps
* runs by status: {'ok': 372}
* **All values in this report come from the deterministic virtual-time emulator (simulator-generated).** They describe the simulator under the stated conditions, not real networks. 'derived' values use a reference or a label that is not itself a measurement of that run (see metric_definitions.json).
* Replicates are independent runs with their own seed; handoffs inside a run are averaged first. Comparisons are matched pairs (same replicate seed = same handoff schedule and loss seed in every approach).

## Limitations

* One-factor-at-a-time design: interactions between conditions are not estimated.
* The emulator has fixed link delays (no jitter, queues or bandwidth limits); loss is independent per packet and direction.
* Handoff timing varies only by the seeded schedule draw; all replicates share the same topology and probe workload.
* TcpLite is a simplified model (no fast retransmit/SACK/congestion control); the QUIC adapter was not runnable here (see not-executed cells).
* Confidence intervals describe sampling variability of the simulator under the stated design; they say nothing about real-world variability.
